name: rippers-hoplosphere
description: Rippers Unmasked — Hoplosphere Economy: a Fabricate crafting-system file + the component Item compendium it binds. Personal-table module.

scripts.zip: rm -f rippers-hoplosphere.zip && zip -r -q rippers-hoplosphere.zip module.json README.md packs system docs macros -x '*/.DS_Store'
scripts.release: gh release create v$npm_package_version -R RoscoeRackham/rippers-hoplosphere --latest --title "rippers-hoplosphere v$npm_package_version" --notes "rippers-hoplosphere v$npm_package_version" ./module.json ./rippers-hoplosphere.zip
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run pack && npm run zip && npm run release
